summary: Tested new CMS admin sectors (CRUD + soft-delete + hide/restore), dynamic sitemap, WhatsApp FAB, sector CTAs as <a>, and JSON-LD schema. Backend: 27/29 pytest tests PASS (13 new admin sector tests + 14 previous regression); the 2 sitemap tests fail because the public URL /sitemap.xml is served by the frontend (static file at /app/frontend/public/sitemap.xml) rather than reaching the FastAPI /sitemap.xml route — ingress routes non-/api paths to port 3000. The backend endpoint IS implemented correctly (verified via curl http://localhost:8001/sitemap.xml, returns dynamic XML including /soluciones and 3 sector URLs) but is unreachable to end-users/search engines. Frontend: WhatsApp FAB present on /soluciones and /soluciones/:slug and hidden on /admin (verified). Sector CTAs are <a href=/api/whatsapp?text=...> with target=_blank and rel=noopener noreferrer. JSON-LD Service schema is injected as <script id='ld-service-inmobiliarias'> with @context schema.org, @type Service, provider PSICOLFIS.NET, and hasOfferCatalog. Admin /Sectores tab shows 3 seeded sectors with badges (/SLUG, SIN PICKAXE), filters (Activos/Ocultos/Papelera/Todos), +Nuevo sector; Editar opens the sector-editor-modal. Hide→public flow verified: hiding inmobiliarias from admin removes it from /soluciones after reload, unhide brings it back.

critical.issue: Public URL is served by the frontend static file (/app/frontend/public/sitemap.xml), NOT by the FastAPI dynamic endpoint. K8s ingress routes only /api/* to backend:8001; /sitemap.xml goes to frontend:3000 which serves the outdated static file with only 3 URLs (/, /agentes, /legal) and NO sector routes. Result: SEO impact — Google will see stale sitemap without /soluciones or per-sector URLs. Backend endpoint itself works correctly on localhost:8001.

action_items: Fix /sitemap.xml routing: either delete /app/frontend/public/sitemap.xml AND expose the backend route under /api/sitemap.xml (then set a redirect / SPA fallback for /sitemap.xml → /api/sitemap.xml at the ingress level), OR update the build step to have the frontend fetch and serve the backend's sitemap dynamically. The most reliable fix in this K8s ingress setup is: rename the backend route to /api/sitemap.xml AND add a simple frontend redirect (or delete public/sitemap.xml so React SPA responds — but SPA won't return XML). Best: keep /sitemap.xml at root but configure ingress so /sitemap.xml is proxied to backend (add rewrite rule).
Optional: expose deployment_id via admin CRUD so filling Pickaxe IDs unlocks the iframe without redeploy.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is now ~3475 lines (was 2965). Growth from adding AdminSectors, SectorEditorModal, WhatsAppFAB and JSON-LD helpers. Strongly recommend splitting into pages/AdminPage, pages/SectorPage, pages/SolucionesIndex, components/WhatsAppFAB, components/AdminSectors — exceeds the 700-line guideline by 5x.
The /sitemap.xml endpoint should either be mounted under /api or a proxying rule added so it is reachable from the public URL. Current implementation is dead code in production.

server.py sitemap endpoint is defined on `app` (not `api_router`) which is correct in intent — but Kubernetes ingress rules make it unreachable. Consider adding a fallback route @api_router.get('/sitemap.xml') OR document the required ingress rule.
In admin_update_sector, when renaming a slug that stays the same (new_slug == slug) no collision check is done — fine because it's the same doc; behavior OK.
SECTOR_CATALOGUE seed data references PICKAXE_DEPLOYMENT_SECTOR_* env vars which are empty in preview → 'SIN PICKAXE' badges are expected.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression pytest: /app/backend/tests/test_admin_sectors_and_sitemap.py + /app/backend/tests/test_sectors_and_regression.py. The two sitemap failures are NOT flaky — they are a real ingress routing issue: frontend /public/sitemap.xml intercepts the URL before FastAPI. If main agent decides to keep the static file (accepting the SEO trade-off), update the tests to fetch localhost:8001/sitemap.xml directly and mark the public URL as WONTFIX. To re-test after fix: curl -sI $REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL/sitemap.xml and confirm the body contains <loc>...psicolfis.net/soluciones</loc> and per-sector <loc> entries. Frontend testids: soluciones-card-<slug>, sector-cta-whatsapp, sector-final-cta-whatsapp, whatsapp-fab, admin-tab-sectors, sector-editor-modal, sector-form-slug/name/deployment/save.
rca of the issue: RCA (sitemap): FastAPI declares @app.get('/sitemap.xml') to serve a dynamic sitemap. However, the K8s ingress rule directs only paths starting with '/api' to backend:8001; all other paths (including '/sitemap.xml') go to frontend:3000. The React dev-server (and prod nginx serving /build) finds /app/frontend/public/sitemap.xml and returns that static file with a stale/reduced list. The FastAPI endpoint is only reachable via internal localhost:8001, so end-users and search engines only ever see the static file. Mitigation options: (a) move endpoint to /api/sitemap.xml and add a frontend build-time redirect/proxy for /sitemap.xml → /api/sitemap.xml, (b) delete public/sitemap.xml and configure ingress with a specific route for /sitemap.xml → backend, or (c) generate the static file at deploy time from the DB. Verified backend logic is correct via `curl http://localhost:8001/sitemap.xml` returning the expected XML with all 4 static paths + 3 active sector paths.
